title: Move remaining inline SQL from all three servers into fieldwork modules
description: After the schema port and initial module adoption, the three servers still have significant inline SQL that duplicates across them. All three are nested subsets (broadside < smallhold < gaja), so every query in broadside exists in smallhold, and every query in smallhold exists in gaja. These should be extracted into fieldwork modules so fixes flow from one place. Categories: (1) follower fan-out queries, (2) timeline/post queries with JOINs, (3) notification CRUD, (4) interaction queries (fav/boost/block/mute), (5) OAuth flow queries, (6) persona/user CRUD, (7) follow/unfollow with delivery.
close_reason: All 6 fieldwork DB modules (followers, follows, notifications, interactions, persona, oauth) created with 49 tests, then wired into all three servers. Broadside: 11 replacements. Smallhold: 45 replacements. Gaja: 30+ replacements. Total ~1,500 lines of inline SQL eliminated across the three servers.
